chapter: Family lore, Boston and Europe with Sam Price
title: First European tour: Paris and Brussels
summary: They played nightclubs and shows; Margaret recalls that he first voted the day he returned.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: Was that the very first time you were ever in Europe?
Where were you playing in 1958 in Paris, do you remember?
No, I don't know. We played so many different places. Some steady nightclubs and then we did shows for -
Yeah. We played in Brussels; I wish I was still there.
How did they like the band, the French?
When you came back after your first visit to Europe ...

You know, that's the first time he ever voted. That's when Rockefeller first went in. I took him to the voting place myself. That's the first time he ever voted, he said, in his life, first time. You know I always vote. We went across the street and we voted. After he got off the boat, I waited two and a half hours for this man to get off that boat, 'cause you know they let the first class off first. They were traveling tourist and then the last ones gets off the last. I brought him down, we went to the school where we voted, and then I went on to work. I never knew you couldn't get off a boat in a hurry. ... Sam Price had you all traveling tourist and you know for weeks Jay was eating breakfast like this. (LAUGHTER)
